_doc: The chercheur's continuous mind (owner 2026-10-02). It reads this FIRST
every night and writes it LAST. Nothing here is overwritten by the app;
only the chercheur edits it. Members never see this file directly - the
night report's beliefs are the top of `hypotheses`, in plain words.
hypotheses: what it believes, with a status (nouveau / en test / renforce /
affaibli / rejete / dans le robot), the evidence trail (one line per night
it moved), and what would settle it next.
tried: every what-if it ran or proposed, the result, so it never repeats
scrutiny_log: which facts/piles it examined on which night, and what it saw.
lessons: things it learned about the data itself (traps, noise floors).
open: questions it has not answered yet, ranked.

lessons: 2026-10-02: the two halves differ hugely (33% vs 74% win) - almost every bucket shows agree=false for that reason alone; read a bucket's halves against the overall halves, not against each other.

2026-10-03: the CLI harness is RAW (no daily cap, no jar, no kill line, flat lot): its base is 185 net / hole 80, not the battery's 136 / 50. Say 'sans plafond ni protections' when quoting it; the battery on both shapes decides.
2026-10-03: --drag charges only the variant, not the printed base. Compare against base minus drag x base trades (~0.57 x 250 = 143) by hand.
2026-10-03: target settings are jagged on money (0.85 +7, 0.9 +58, 0.95 -32, 1.0 +40) but steady on the hole. Trust the hole trend more than one setting's money.
